policy.purpose: Known runtime projection drifts are retained as evidence and monitored without making scheduled validation permanently red.
policy.fail_rule: Fail runtime validation only for new/unclassified drift, changed known-drift values, missing runtime identities, or runtime access failures.
policy.resolve_rule: If a known drift disappears, report it as RESOLVED_CANDIDATE and require registry review before deletion.
policy.authority: Known runtime drift never changes normative Games Workshop/MFM facts.
